segments.name: Freelance graphic designers
segments.problem: Need professional forms for client intake and surveys without coding or expense
segments.access: Accessible via freelance platforms like Upwork and Behance public profiles
segments.tradeoff: Lower volume but highly motivated, direct communication possible

segments.name: Startup founders in early product validation
segments.problem: Quickly build professional surveys and feedback forms for user research without coding
segments.access: Accessible through startup community platforms and LinkedIn entrepreneur groups
segments.tradeoff: Moderate access cost, higher payoff if product fits urgent research needs

segments.name: Event planners organizing medium-sized events
segments.problem: Need customizable registration and feedback forms without complex tools
segments.access: Public event planning groups on Facebook and Meetup, event vendor lists
segments.tradeoff: Easy access but buying urgency varies based on event timing

firstBuyerWhy: Freelance graphic designers combine urgent workflow needs, self-service comfort, and ready authority over vendor tool decisions, making them ideal initial adopters. Startup founders come second when validation demands is
paymentPath: Trial to paid subscription upgrade after form volume or feature use justifies payment

firstExperiment.problem: Freelancers struggle to build attractive client intake forms without coding
firstExperiment.identifyProspects: Search Upwork profiles marked graphic design and active past months; confirm portfolio includes client communication needs
firstExperiment.channel: Direct email outreach using platform contact info
firstExperiment.channelRationale: Email allows personalized invitations showing form ease and design benefits
firstExperiment.firstAction: Send introductory email to 10 freelance graphic designers

resources.assumptions: No paid ads budget; only cold email and manual profiling

firstExperiment.commercialLearning: Understand freelancers’ urgency for form creation, acceptance of self-service pricing, initial activation and feedback
firstExperiment.continueWhen: At least 2 recipients respond with interest or request trial
firstExperiment.adjustWhen: No responses after 10 emails; consider LinkedIn messaging alternative
firstExperiment.stopWhen: No response after 20 emails or negative feedback on self-service preference

alternatives.comparison: More personal but slower and requires platform familiarity
alternatives.preferWhen: Email yields no engagement but LinkedIn profiles are rich and active
alternatives.firstAction: Send personalized LinkedIn InMail to 10 freelancers

alternatives.comparison: High effort, lower evidence speed, but direct platform access
alternatives.preferWhen: Cold email and LinkedIn fail; platform bids allow proactive engagement
alternatives.firstAction: Submit tailored proposals to 5 freelance graphic design jobs

messages.subject: Quick way to create stunning client forms — free & no code
messages.body: Hi [Name], noticed your great design work. Would you try Tally to create beautiful client intake forms easily? No coding, unlimited free forms. Can I share a link?

messages.subject: Following up: can Tally simplify your client forms?
messages.body: Hi [Name], just checking if you saw my note about Tally’s free easy form builder? Happy to help you get started for your client projects?

positioning: Tally empowers freelance graphic designers to create customizable, professional client intake and survey forms without any coding or costs, enhancing their workflow and client experience.
